note: Written before any pilot model was trained or scored. Heuristic baselines were already known from RD-03; candidate (model) numbers were not.

decision_rule.PROMISING: ALL of: (a) false-Hapus rate (P(pred FIVE | true not FIVE)) on the held-out subject-disjoint test split <= the revised heuristic's; (b) FIVE recall >= revised heuristic's FIVE recall - 0.02; (c) macro-F1 over the 9 classes >= revised heuristic's + 0.03; (d) JS inference p95 <= 1.0 ms per hand in the Node runtime (budget: 33 ms frame at 30 fps, shared with MediaPipe).
decision_rule.REJECTED: Any of (a) or (b) violated, or macro-F1 below the revised heuristic.
decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: A required class has fewer than 200 held-out rows, or the held-out split shares a subject with training.
decision_rule.BLOCKED: Data, license or runtime prevents the measurement.

selection: Hyper-parameters and the epoch are chosen on the VALIDATION split only. The TEST split is scored once per model after selection.
no_install: No model is installed into gameplay or the lab gesture path. Any lab A/B switch (RD-06) needs the Owner.

amendment_before_candidate_results.reason: RD-03 (heuristics only, no candidate model scored yet) showed the repo's thumb-up pose fires on 82% of HaGRID `fist` rows in BOTH rule sets, and the heuristics have no label for natural hands. FIST and THUMB_UP therefore measure a definition mismatch, not the model.
amendment_before_candidate_results.criterion_c_now: macro-F1 over the 7 labels FIVE, FOUR, THREE, TWO, ONE, PINCH_LIKE, OTHER (FIST and THUMB_UP excluded). The 9-label macro-F1 is still reported next to it.
